notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the original FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001594805-26-000007, filed February 11, 2026), reporting in US dollars. Shopify files no DEF 14A; its security ownership disclosure is Item 12 of the Form 10-K/A Amendment No. 1 (accession 0001594805-26-000011, filed April 29, 2026), which adds Part III only and does not restate the financial statements, as at April 21, 2026. LEADER: Tobias Lütke is CEO. The filing states class percentages (0.13% of Class A, 99.59% of Class B, the one Founder Share) and 40.02% of aggregate voting power, but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the 6.11% is in leader.derived. It counts shares owned, controlled or directed: 1,290,000 Class A and 66,130,362 Class B held by 7910240 Canada Inc. and 258,000 Class A held by Thistledown Foundation, which Lütke is deemed to own, plus 11,619,770 Class B held directly. The beneficial-ownership table, which also counts 786,822 Class A shares from options and RSUs (exercisable or vesting within 60 days), shows him with 2,334,822 Class A shares (less than 1% of Class A); on that SEC basis (option and RSU shares added to numerator and denominator) the derived figure would be 6.16% rather than 6.11%. HOLDERS: the filing says Lütke is the only person or entity known to own more than 5% of any class, so largestHolders is empty. CASH: no dividends have ever been paid; the FY2025 financing section shows only option-exercise proceeds and the $1,043 million maturity of convertible notes, and Item 5 reports no issuer purchases of equity securities, so buybacks are 0. The board authorized a repurchase program of up to $2 billion of Class A shares in February 2026, after the fiscal year. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back equals the XBRL-tagged stock-based compensation expense ($449 million).
